kit.title: Christmas gifts for mom she will actually use
kit.hook: Picture this: December 23rd, and Mom still says she wants nothing.

scenes.narration: Picture this: it is December 23rd. You ask Mom what she wants, again. "Nothing, sweetheart." Again.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a calendar page on December 23 next to a phone mid-call

scenes.narration: Nothing means nothing she can name. So look at what she does all day.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a wrapped gift on a kitchen table next to a cold cup of tea

scenes.narration: Misses the grandkids? A Wi-Fi photo frame the whole family can send photos to. Skylight takes photos by email, so nobody needs an app.
Always cold on the couch? A weighted blanket, about ten percent of her body weight.
scenes.visual: product:Gravity weighted blanket on a couch

scenes.narration: Tea always goes cold? The Ember Mug 2 holds her temperature up to an hour and a half off its coaster.
Reads in bed? An e-reader. The Kobo Clara BW is the lighter one, at 174 grams.
And skip the vacuum. A chore with a bow on it is still a chore.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a vacuum with a big red bow, slowly wheeled back out of frame

scenes.narration: Christmas morning: twenty grandkid photos are already on the frame. She says you shouldn't have. She means it kindly.
scenes.visual: product:Skylight frame with a new photo arriving

scenes.narration: The full list, and what to skip, is at the link.
